patterns.guidance: When workspace dependency resolution changes, align declared Node engines with required transitive engines and verify engine-strict frozen installation plus builds/tests on the declared minimum runtime.

When base endpoints forbid query/fragment components, reject literal delimiters before inspecting parsed URL.search/hash; empty components normalize to empty strings. Preserve percent-encoded path punctuation and test both cases.

When serializing unknown data into a required envelope field, verify that serialized output retains the field; JSON.stringify can silently omit functions, symbols and toJSON-returning-undefined values without throwing.
